tests.name: CheckIfInstallable method call
tests.description:
Executes the CheckIfInstallable class constructor runner instead of executing InstallUtil. Upon execution, the InstallUtil test harness will be executed.
If no output is displayed the test executed successfuly.

tests.name: InstallHelper method call
tests.description:
Executes the InstallHelper class constructor runner instead of executing InstallUtil. Upon execution, no output will be displayed if the test
executed successfuly.

tests.name: InstallUtil class constructor method call
tests.description: Executes the installer assembly class constructor. Upon execution, version information will be displayed the .NET framework install utility.

tests.name: InstallUtil Install method call
tests.description: Executes the Install Method. Upon execution, version information will be displayed the .NET framework install utility.

tests.name: InstallUtil Uninstall method call - /U variant
tests.description: Executes the Uninstall Method. Upon execution, version information will be displayed the .NET framework install utility.

tests.name: InstallUtil Uninstall method call - '/installtype=notransaction /action=uninstall' variant
tests.description: Executes the Uninstall Method. Upon execution, version information will be displayed the .NET framework install utility.

tests.name: InstallUtil HelpText method call
tests.description: Executes the Uninstall Method. Upon execution, help information will be displayed for InstallUtil.

tests.name: InstallUtil evasive invocation
tests.description:
Executes an InstallUtil assembly by renaming InstallUtil.exe and using a nonstandard extension for the assembly. Upon execution, "Running a transacted installation."
will be displayed, along with other information about the opperation. "The transacted install has completed." will be displayed upon completion.
